title: 第30章  魔功妖人
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
苏定安顿了顿，脸色变得凝重了几分。

    “从那之后，沈家的宅子就变了。”

    “方圆百丈之内，只要有人靠近，就会凭空冒出一些水墨凝成的黑影。”

    “这些黑影没有固定的形状，有的像人，有的像兽，有的就像信手涂鸦没有名状。”

    “没人知道它们是怎么出现的，也许前一刻面前还空无一物，后一刻就有一道黑影扑杀而来。”

    苏定安的声音带着几分忌惮。

    “这些东西神出鬼没，数量极多，临川县驻所的人称其为墨灵。”

    “根据赵衡所述，他进沈家宅子那一次，遇到的墨灵密密麻麻，怕是有上百个之多。”

    “而且，这些东西很难杀！”

    陆渊眉头微动。

    “普通刀剑砍上去就像是砍在水里，虽说能毁其形体，但转眼就复原，造不成任何伤害。”

    “想要真正伤到它们，就得用灵力催动兵刃。”

    “赵衡初境后期的修为，镇魔铁扇斩了三扇才杀死一只墨灵，那些普通镇魔卫至少也要十刀才行。”

    “而且，越往里走，墨灵越强，据说剑堂附近的那几只形态与真人无异，手里还拿着水墨兵刃。”

    陆渊沉吟片刻，“临川县驻所的人手呢？”

    苏定安摇了摇头，“这就是问题所在了。”

    “临川县不大，以往也没闹过几次妖患，州司并没有派遣镇魔统领坐镇此地。”

    “有赵衡这种顶尖镇魔校尉在，外加五名镇魔卫与一应衙役足矣应对。”

    “可现在沈家周遭墨灵遍地，根据赵衡的估计，至少得来一队装备精良的镇魔卫才行。”

    一队也就是五十人，相当于长生教在赤霞县的一个分舵了。

    按照这个数量来算，眼下临川县驻所的人手还不够那些墨灵塞牙缝的。

    陆渊点了点头，沉默片刻问道：“那幅古画里的仕女呢？”

    “没人见过。”苏定安摇头，“赵衡说他在剑堂里感应到了一股极强的妖气，但没找到正主。”

    “依我看，那东西应该是躲在幕后，操控沈玉楼和那些墨灵当打手。”

    说到这里，苏定安突然缩了缩脖子。

    “对了，还有一个邪门的地方，那些墨灵杀人的方式很诡异，被它们杀死的人浑身上下没有任何伤口，但会变得灰蒙蒙的。”

    “那些死者被抬出来的时候，无论是身体还是衣服都是一片灰败，就像是水墨画里的人。”

    “大人，您说那妖魔究竟想干什么？把人变成画？这也太诡异了些......”

    陆渊语气平静淡淡开口：“跟妖魔费什么心思？不管它想干什么，斩了便是。”

    苏定安一愣，认同地点了点头。

    “那倒也是。”

    ......
content_en:
Su Dingan paused, and his expression became a little more solemn.

    "Since then, the Shen family's house has changed."

    "Within a hundred feet radius, as long as someone approaches, some black shadows made of ink will appear out of thin air."

    "These black shadows have no fixed shape. Some look like people, some look like animals, and some are just like scribbles without names."

    "No one knows how they appeared. Maybe there was nothing in front of them one moment, and then there was a black shadow chasing them the next moment."

    Su Ding'an's voice was a bit fearful.

    "These things are so elusive and so numerous that the people stationed in Linchuan County call them Mo Ling."

    "According to what Zhao Heng said, the time he entered the Shen family's house, he encountered so many Mo Lings, there were probably hundreds of them."

    "Besides, these things are hard to kill!"

    Lu Yuan's brows moved slightly.

    "Chopping with an ordinary sword is like cutting into water. Although it can destroy its shape, it will recover in an instant and cannot cause any harm."

    "If you want to really hurt them, you have to use spiritual power to activate the weapon."

    "Zhao Heng's cultivation at the late stage of the first realm required three blows from the Demon-Suppressing Iron Fan to kill a black spirit. Those ordinary Demon-Suppressing Guards would have needed at least ten blows to do so."

    "Moreover, the further you go in, the stronger the ink spirits become. It is said that the ones near the sword hall are in the same shape as real people, and they still hold ink weapons in their hands."

    Lu Yuan pondered for a moment, "Where are the manpower at the Linchuan County station?"

    Su Ding'an shook his head, "That's the problem."

    "Linchuan County is not big, and there have not been many demon troubles in the past. The Prefectural Secretary has not sent a demon-suppressing commander to sit here."

    "With a top-notch demon-suppressing captain like Zhao Heng here, plus five demon-suppressing guards and a yamen officer, it is enough to deal with it."

    "But now there are Mo spirits everywhere around the Shen family. According to Zhao Heng's estimation, at least a team of well-equipped demon-suppressing guards are needed."

    One team consists of fifty people, which is equivalent to a branch of the Changsheng Sect in Chixia County.

    Based on this number, the current manpower at the Linchuan County Station is not enough for those Mo Lings who have teeth to fill.

    Lu Yuan nodded, remained silent for a moment and asked, "Where is the lady in that ancient painting?"

    "No one has seen it." Su Ding'an shook his head, "Zhao Heng said he sensed a very strong demonic energy in the sword hall, but he couldn't find the real owner."

    "In my opinion, that thing should be hiding behind the scenes and controlling Shen Yulou and those Mo Lings as thugs."

    Speaking of this, Su Ding'an suddenly shrank his neck.

    "By the way, there is another evil place. The way those ink spirits kill people is very weird. The people they kill don't have any wounds on their bodies, but they will become gray."

    "When the deceased were carried out, both their bodies and clothes were in a state of gray and decay, just like people in ink paintings."

    "Sir, what do you think the demon wants to do? Turn people into paintings? This is too weird..."

    Lu Yuan spoke calmly: "Why bother with the monster? No matter what it wants to do, just kill it."

    Su Ding'an was stunned and nodded in agreement.

    "That's true."
